title: Supreme Leader Snoke
subtitle: The First Order
description: As Supreme Leader of the First Order, Snoke was a powerful user of the dark side and of mysterious origins. He seduced Ben Solo to the dark side and helped him on his journey to become Kylo Ren. Snoke ruled with otter ruthlessness and confidence, unable to guess or sense that his apprentice would turn on him and cut him in half at a most inopportune moment.
